notes.group:comfort-entry-driver-seat: VAGCoder/fixtures/private/coding-artifact-review/managed/CarScannerMaui.Coding.DB.MQB.Seats.decompiled.cs Seats.MQB_36_ComfortEntryDriverSide (lines 10-130): MQBMultipleCoding of 3 parts. Part1 MQBEasyCodingItem 36 (74C/7B6) DID 0600: Enable sets SwitchBitInByte(3,1)+(9,6), Disable clears both. Part2 MQBAlternativeCoding 5F (773/7DD) first-match containers 0B3C [bits 14.0,14.2] then 0B1B [IsMIB3 ? bits 14.7,14.5 : bits 14.0,14.2]. Part3 containers 0B3D [16.0=value, 16.1..16.3 cleared] then 0B1D [IsMIB3 ? array[16]=99/0 : same as 0B3D]. Replaces the extractor field on 0B3C (bitLength 3 = 5) which would also have forced bit 14.1; vendor only touches bits 0 and 2. Vendor passwords empty -> unit default.
notes.group:comfort-entry-passenger-seat: VAGCoder/fixtures/private/coding-artifact-review/managed/CarScannerMaui.Coding.DB.MQB.Seats.decompiled.cs Seats.MQB_06_ComfortEntryPassengerSide (lines 132-268): 4 parts. Part1 MQBEasyCodingItem 06 (74D/7B7) DID 0600: bits 3.1, 6.4, 9.6 set/cleared. Part2 = same 0B3C/0B1B pair as driver (byte 14). Part3 0B3D [32.0=value, 32.1..32.3 cleared] / 0B1D [IsMIB3 ? array[32]=99/0 : as 0B3D]. Part4 (already a correct field in the corpus) = 36 0600 bit 6.4.

notes.csmqb-mqb-5-f-developer-mode-activation: VAGCoder/fixtures/private/coding-artifact-review/managed/CarScannerMaui.Coding.DB.MQB.Multimedia.decompiled.cs Multimedia.MQB_5F_DeveloperModeActivation (lines 349-369): 5F DID 243F, Enable array[0]=1 else array[0]=0. Vendor sets PreWriteCommands = "104F" (switch 5F to diagnostic session 0x4F before the write) - carried as sequence.pre; the writer must send it before 2E243F or the write may get NRC 7F/31.
notes.comfort:multimedia-startup-logo: carscanner-candidates.json csadapt-10077 (Adaptation@773:0600, byte18 whole byte, MIB2 long coding) and csadapt-10231 (Adaptation@773:0556 byte1, MIB3 adaptation channel) - same option list. Combined as alt mib25/mib3 (isMib3 from F19E/ASAM) so a MIB3 unit never gets byte18 of its differently-laid-out 0600. notes.csadapt-10335: mqbadaptations.db '[MIB3] Dashboard settings in MMI: Over threshold high' = 5F 0B1B byte23 bit5, DISABLE 0 / ENABLE 1. The vendor marks it MIB3-only, and MIB2.5 units host a differently laid-out 0B1B (Seats.MQB_36_ComfortEntryDriverSide writes 0B1B byte14 with separate IsMIB3 branches), so the field is wrapped as an alt with a single 'mib3' variant (variant-select MIB rule, isMib3 from F19E/ASAM): a MIB2.5 head unit, or one whose generation cannot be read, refuses instead of having byte 23 of a foreign layout changed. Same DID, bit and values as before.
